findings.issue: The entity moves by about 7.2 km between quarters and Q2 address, coordinates and current market location disagree; possible entity collision or ID reuse.
findings.resolution: Root cause confirmed by cross-checking against independent research already done this session on this exact building (address/GBA verified against Kommersant and other sources before this handoff surfaced): the Q2 2026 (202606, live) record was already correct (address ул. Сущевский Вал 5, lat 55.755996/lng 37.536535, gba 208330). The Q1 2026 (202603) record was corrupted — its address had been overwritten with 'улица Антонова-Овсеенко, вл. 13-15' (which belongs to neither Север.Сити nor even Aurus, a separate project that shares the same developer and was independently confirmed correct at 2-й Красногвардейский проезд), and its gba (393264) was a straight duplicate of Aurus's true gba, with gla (208330) actually holding Север.Сити's true gba value — a combined address-swap + gba/gla-swap bug isolated to the 202603 snapshot. Restored 202603 to match the verified-correct 202606 values (address, gba=208330, gla=186009, lat, lng). No entity collision with a different project — same entity, corrupted single-quarter import. data/lots_202606.json was not touched (issue was isolated to the buildings file).
findings.resolution_round2: Codex's round-2 finding was RIGHT and round 1's 'already correct' conclusion was WRONG — round 1 only checked that 202603 and 202606 agreed with each other, never checked whether the shared coordinate actually matched the shared address in the real world. It didn't: 55.755996,37.536535 is Пресненский район / Большой Сити (Moscow-City), point-in-polygon confirmed via scripts/recompute_geo.py. Independently verified project identity via WebFetch of https://severcity.moscow/ (self-described as an unofficial informational page, not the developer's own domain — flagging this caveat) which explicitly ties Север.Сити to метро Рижская / Марьина Роща (СВАО), consistent with the stored street name 'Сущёвский Вал' (confirmed via ru.wikipedia.org that this street runs through Марьина Роща). Re-geocoded the stored address via Yandex Geocoder: precision=exact/house at 55.794811,37.592464, which independently point-in-polygon resolves to Марьина Роща — i.e. two independent methods (official page's district claim, and geocoding the address) agree with each other. GBA=208330 (already independently confirmed earlier this session) is unaffected — this is a location fix only, not an identity fix; found no evidence of a second/different entity being conflated. Applied corrected lat/lng to data/buildings_202603.json, data/buildings_202606.json, and classifier.html, plus recomputed geo-fields (ao Центральный→Северо-Восточный, raion Пресненский→Марьина Роща, zone СК-ТТК→ТТК-МКАД, submarket ТТК Запад→ТТК-МКАД Север, bizForming Большой Сити→Савеловский деловой район). Colored green (2 independent, mutually-consistent confirmations). Requesting Codex specifically re-verify this one against a stronger primary source if available (Мосгосстройнадзор permit records or the developer's actual domain) — severcity.moscow's own disclaimer that it's unofficial is the weakest link in this chain.

findings_round2_additional.title: Deterministic point-in-polygon geo-field recomputation
findings_round2_additional.resolution_round2: Added scripts/recompute_geo.py — pure-Python reimplementation of index.html's pipRing/pointInFeature ray-casting (bbox pre-check + polygon hole handling), reading the same data/*.geojson layers (ao/mo/zones/submarkets/biz_formed/biz_forming) index.html itself uses. Validated with 0 mismatches against 20 existing classifier.html records that already had correct, previously human-verified geo fields, before using it on QA-001/004/006/007 above. NOT yet wired into an automatic pipeline that runs after every lat/lng edit — for now it is a callable/CLI tool (`python3 scripts/recompute_geo.py <lat> <lng>`) a human or agent runs manually after changing coordinates. Full automation (hook into classifier.html generation) is really QA-011's scope, not attempted here.
